sources.title: Adobe Color — color wheel
sources.note: Starting from the icon’s blue and sand, explore tonal, adjacent-hue, and complementary families. The proposed palettes are original.

sources.title: Radix — composing a palette
sources.note: Blue/indigo with slate, teal with sage, and amber with sand informed the neutral and accent pairings.

sources.title: Radix — understanding the scale
sources.note: Separate backgrounds, selected containers, controls, and text rather than using one accent everywhere.

sources.title: Material 3 — color schemes
sources.note: Use brand-derived light and dark color roles, each paired with an appropriate foreground.

sources.title: Android — canonical layouts
sources.note: List/detail for browsing and Saved; supporting panes for the player and queue.

sources.title: Android — reference video
sources.note: Inspected the compact phone and expanded two-pane states; supplied screenshots also guide the desktop arrangement.

sources.title: Android — window size classes
sources.note: Use the current app-window size, including resized desktop windows and split screen.

sources.title: Android — adaptive navigation
sources.note: Bottom navigation and rail adapt to available space. The labeled desktop sidebar is a proposed Storymile choice.

sources.title: Android — fold-aware layouts
sources.note: Respect separating hinges; use tabletop posture to separate content and controls.

sources.title: W3C — minimum contrast
sources.note: Normal text needs 4.5:1. The table checks intended color tokens, not generated image pixels.

notes.title: Phone
notes.text: Below 600dp, show one pane and bottom navigation. Selecting an item opens its detail. Back restores the list and scroll position. Keep the mini-player above navigation.

notes.title: Foldable
notes.text: The 900dp examples can show rail, list, and detail. Narrower unfolded windows may still need one pane. Align content to a separating hinge; transport controls must stay on one side.

notes.title: Tablet and desktop
notes.text: Expanded windows from 840dp can show two content panes. Use a rail, then a labeled sidebar on roomy desktops. Keep forms bounded and text readable; adapt to the app window, not the device name.

notes.title: Selection and playback
notes.text: Resizing preserves the selected episode, query, filters, and playback at 12:34. Narrowing keeps selected detail visible. The player owns one listening session across all destinations.

notes.title: Listening
notes.text: The full player replaces the mini-player. Queue and chapters open in a sheet on phones or a supporting pane on wider windows. In tabletop posture, keep artwork above the fold and controls below.

notes.title: Account and Saved
notes.text: Proposed UX: allow discovery, listening, and local saves as a guest. Sign-in adds sync. Bookmarking saves an episode; downloading is a separate action. Auth providers and sync rules remain product decisions.

notes.title: Color choices
notes.text: Six original palettes extend the live icon’s blue, ivory, and sand. A is the closest match, B its quieter dark counterpart; C and D shift hue, E deepens it, F raises saturation.

notes.title: Reading the boards
notes.text: These are generated visual concepts. Some icons, small labels, and device proportions vary. The HTML color tokens and these behavior notes are the precise reference for a later implementation.

notes.title: Next refinement
notes.text: Choose a color direction and preferred density, then refine individual screens and behavior. The current set contains 12 boards and 62 screen studies across all five requested areas.
